controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Configure DNS records correctly. DNS gate: domains and subdomains must point to correct environments.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for any deployed web application, staging environment, production environment, or public domain.
controls.required_test: Resolve DNS for app, www, api, assets, staging, and mail records where relevant.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: DNS record export, resolver output, environment map.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Separate staging and production domains. Environment gate: staging and production URLs, databases, storage, and credentials must not mix.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for any deployed web application, staging environment, production environment, or public domain.
controls.required_test: Submit data on staging and confirm production remains unchanged.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Environment config, domain list, database and storage separation proof.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Use correct ports. Network exposure gate: only required ports are open and documented.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for any deployed web application, staging environment, production environment, or public domain.
controls.required_test: Port scan expected environment and verify 443 is used for web traffic.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Firewall rule, hosting config, port scan result.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Add network timeouts. Timeout gate: external calls, database calls, WebSocket connections, and jobs must not hang forever.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for external calls, database calls, WebSocket connections, APIs, cron, workers, imports, exports, and integrations.
controls.required_test: Simulate slow dependency and confirm timeout plus user-safe handling.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Timeout config, failure test, log entry.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Add safe retries. Retry gate: retries must have limits, backoff, idempotency, and stop conditions.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for external calls, database calls, WebSocket connections, APIs, cron, workers, imports, exports, and integrations.
controls.required_test: Force transient failure and confirm retry then success or controlled failure.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Retry policy, retry log, duplicate safety test.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Choose TCP or UDP based on reliability needs. Transport gate: protocol choice must match reliability, ordering, and latency requirements.
controls.applicability_rule: Conditional. Apply when choosing real time communication, streaming, gaming, voice, video, DNS style behaviour, or protocol level design.
controls.required_test: Review feature needs and test poor network behaviour.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Protocol decision, network test, fallback note.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Choose SQL or NoSQL based on access pattern. Database choice gate: data model must match query, consistency, scale, and relationship needs.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory when choosing or changing persistence technology, data model, query pattern, or reporting design.
controls.required_test: Validate core queries against the proposed database type.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Database decision record, access pattern table, prototype query result.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Track availability. Availability gate: uptime target and health checks must exist for production features.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for production and staging. Conditional only for throwaway local experiments, with reason recorded.
controls.required_test: Take one dependency down and observe health result.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Health check endpoint, uptime monitor screenshot, SLA note.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Track throughput. Throughput gate: expected requests, jobs, queries, and bytes per second must be estimated or measured.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for production and staging. Conditional only for throwaway local experiments, with reason recorded.
controls.required_test: Run a small load test on critical path.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Load test output, capacity assumption, metric dashboard.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Track latency. Latency gate: p95 and p99 response time must be measured for critical user paths.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for production and staging. Conditional only for throwaway local experiments, with reason recorded.
controls.required_test: Run repeated requests and inspect latency distribution.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Latency dashboard, p95 and p99 result, slow path note.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Log requests and errors. Logging gate: important requests, errors, denials, and failed jobs must be observable without exposing secrets.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for production and staging. Conditional only for throwaway local experiments, with reason recorded.
controls.required_test: Trigger errors and confirm useful sanitized logs.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Log sample, redaction rule, error tracking issue.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Track CPU, latency, and failures. Metrics gate: infrastructure and application metrics must show saturation and failure signals.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for production and staging. Conditional only for throwaway local experiments, with reason recorded.
controls.required_test: Create controlled load and watch CPU, latency, error count.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Metrics dashboard, alert threshold, load result.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Add alerts. Alert gate: critical thresholds must notify responsible people before silent failure grows.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for production and staging. Conditional only for throwaway local experiments, with reason recorded.
controls.required_test: Trigger test alert or use synthetic check.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Alert rule, notification screenshot, incident routing note.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Remove single points of failure where justified. Resilience gate: critical components must identify redundancy or accepted risk.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory as a risk register. Redundancy depth depends on uptime target, budget, hosting, and business criticality.
controls.required_test: Kill or disable one component in staging where practical.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Single point of failure register, failover test, risk acceptance.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Add redundancy where uptime matters. Redundancy gate: critical app, database, cache, storage, DNS, and queue components need backup path where justified.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory as a risk register. Redundancy depth depends on uptime target, budget, hosting, and business criticality.
controls.required_test: Fail primary component and confirm fallback or documented downtime.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Redundancy design, failover result, recovery note.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Test failure cases. Failure gate: every known failure path must return safe state and useful message.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory before acceptance. The exact test depth depends on the feature risk and deployment environment.
controls.required_test: Run negative tests for validation, auth, permissions, DB, email, cache, network, and file failures.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Negative test checklist, screenshots, logs.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Test traffic growth. Traffic gate: high request volume must not break critical paths.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory before acceptance. The exact test depth depends on the feature risk and deployment environment.
controls.required_test: Load test with realistic concurrent users.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Load test report, bottleneck list, remediation plan.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Test data growth. Data growth gate: large tables, files, logs, and reports must remain usable.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory before acceptance. The exact test depth depends on the feature risk and deployment environment.
controls.required_test: Seed large data and run screens, APIs, searches, and exports.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Seed script, timing result, query plan.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Test cache failure. Cache failure gate: app must survive cache miss, cache outage, stale cache, and mass expiry.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory before acceptance. The exact test depth depends on the feature risk and deployment environment.
controls.required_test: Disable cache or expire many keys under load.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Cache outage test, fallback result, database load metric.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Test deployment failure. Deployment gate: failed build, failed migration, failed smoke test, and rollback must be rehearsed.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory before acceptance. The exact test depth depends on the feature risk and deployment environment.
controls.required_test: Force a staging deployment failure and recover.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Deployment log, rollback procedure, smoke test result.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Document trade-offs. Trade-off gate: speed, reliability, scale, cost, simplicity, and security trade-offs must be written down.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for every feature accepted into a real product or business system.
controls.required_test: Review ADR against chosen architecture.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Architecture decision record, rejected alternatives, approval note.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Document recovery steps. Recovery gate: restore, rollback, incident, and support steps must be clear enough for another operator.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for every feature accepted into a real product or business system.
controls.required_test: Follow the recovery document in staging.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Recovery runbook, restore drill result, owner list.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Document operational ownership. Ownership gate: each production feature must have owner, support path, logs, alerts, and escalation route.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for every feature accepted into a real product or business system.
controls.required_test: Ask who handles failure and verify named owner exists.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Ownership matrix, support note, alert recipient list.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Add RLS or row scoped access. Access isolation gate: RLS, tenant policies, owner checks, or row scoped queries must prevent cross-user and cross-tenant leakage.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory for any private, multi user, tenant, organisation, admin, owner, account, dashboard, export, report, or resource access.
controls.required_test: User A attempts read, update, delete, export, and infer User B data.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: RLS policy or row scope code, cross-tenant test, denied access log.

controls.gate_and_acceptance_condition: Add security controls beyond the lecture before production acceptance. Security completion gate: auth, RBAC, CSRF, CORS, CSP, HSTS, secrets, rate limits, audits, dependency checks, and privacy controls must be reviewed.
controls.applicability_rule: Mandatory before production acceptance. It is a blocking security closure row.
controls.required_test: Run security checklist, abuse cases, dependency scan, header scan, and permission tests.
controls.evidence_before_acceptance: Security checklist, scan reports, threat model, approval evidence.
